protocol_metadata.name: Pragmatic Vertical Blocks Protocol (PVBP)
protocol_metadata.based_on: Critical evaluation of TVIP and practical requirements
protocol_metadata.philosophy: Maintain vertical integration benefits while solving temporal issues with standard patterns

specification.location: Top of each vertical block file

requirements: Must use dynamic import with ssr: false

universal.description: Works on both server and client

standard_pattern_library.usage_strategy: Copy patterns into blocks as needed, maintain self-containment

server_blocks.testing_approach: Node.js environment tests, mock server resources

universal_blocks.testing_approach: Test in both Node.js and JSDOM environments

new_block_creation: 1. Determine RUNTIME category based on functionality
2. Create file with appropriate naming convention
3. Add RUNTIME constant declaration at top
4. Select and copy needed lifecycle patterns

error_handling.principle: Each block handles its own errors

state_management.async_state: React Query or SWR for client blocks

implementation_phase: Replace useEffect with useEffectOnce where appropriate
Wrap browser API calls with useClientOnly
migration_checklist.rollback_plan: Remove RUNTIME constant and patterns to revert

e2e_tests.cross_browser: Test client blocks in multiple browsers

extension_points: Additional RUNTIME types can be added
New patterns can extend the library
